predecessor_issue: R21 image_gen in a long history twice generated annotated multi-panel posters instead of exactly one transparent wordmark; reserved holdout contaminated
hypothesis: A new ChatGPT conversation with no prior design history and a concise explicit positive/negative prompt may yield compliant single-asset output
actual_carrier: Connected Opera Neon opens separate regular https://chatgpt.com/ chat in Chat mode, not Work; user remains authenticated. Fresh chat, no prior turns. One message max.
frozen_prompt: 请直接调用图片生成，只生成一张图片，不要文字解释。新图为16:9横幅，透明背景，画面中间单排、准确无误的四个简体中文字：青石晚风。只有这四个字，黑色端正宋体风格，字距自然。不得出现其他文字、拼音、字母、数字、编号、Logo、边框、背景场景、山水、装饰纹理、附注、方案展示板或拼图。不要给出A/B/C方案。完成时只输出生成图片。

controls.target_output: One image asset with exactly '青石晚风' in standard simplified Chinese; single horizontal row; transparent background; no other content
technical_review: Record newly created conversation permalink if surfaced
Capture actual generated preview pixels without OCR if accessible
Check PNG dimensions and true alpha if obtainable
Record input, model/seed unknown if unavailable
No synthetic claims of API knobs

stop: On first tool-generated image or observed contract failure, stop; no silent prompt tweaks, rerequests or resampling.
next_if_pass: Plan truly fair new A/B on untouched text with model-output-bound rendering and independent design review.
next_if_fail: Mark native ChatGPT image carrier unreliable; use programmable vector production to guarantee text and transparency. Keep aesthetics separate and do not spend Firefly credits without approval.
